title: CommunityRoutingSignals
description: Frozen T26 contract for skills/community/routing-signals.json (schema version 1.0). Curated routing signal layer for the 293 adapted community skills. The whole vocabulary is the dependency-free draft 2020-12 subset the bundled validator in skills/scripts/test-contract-v2.py supports: type, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, enum, const, oneOf, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, pattern, minItems, maxItems, maxProperties. No $ref/$defs, no allOf/anyOf/not, no if/then/else, no uniqueItems, no format, no patternProperties, no propertyNames. additionalProperties is false everywhere except the token_aliases map, whose members are the data being constrained. Coverage floors (noise >= 4, short_tokens containing the measured 2-character blind spot, token_aliases >= 6, signals >= 20), evidence provenance under design-freeze 1.2, the noise 80%-per-source rule under design-freeze 1.3, and signals[].id uniqueness cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and are enforced by skills/scripts/verify-routing-signals.py, which fails closed on every one of them. must/exclude/noise[].pattern are ECMAScript-style regular expressions; their compilability is also a verifier check because JSON Schema cannot compile a pattern.

schemaVersion.description: Frozen contract version. The only camelCase key in the document, per the 4.0 convention exception that the registry version key also uses.

meta.description: Provenance and ownership of the curated layer. owner and registrySchemaVersion are const so a fork cannot silently claim this contract.

registrySchemaVersion.description: Must equal skills/community/registry.json schemaVersion; the verifier compares the two and fails closed on a mismatch.

consumer.description: The routing engine that consumes this layer.

verifier.description: The gate that validates this document.

token_aliases.description: Curated plural to singular folds, applied on both the hint side and the record side so the mapping is symmetric by construction. This is a curated table, never a general stemmer: a general stemmer is a code change in the tokeniser, this is a data change in one auditable file. maxProperties bounds the table so the layer cannot grow into an unmeasured general stemmer.

short_tokens.description: Two-character tokens the tokeniser must admit as whole tokens. The global minimum token length stays at 3: lowering it globally was rejected because it would admit arbitrary ASCII fragments, so exactly these literals are extended instead. Must contain the measured blind spot {ad, ci, db, id, io, os, ot, s3}. 'ai' is deliberately absent: the routing view hyphen-splits ai-fullstack, so it was present in 157 of 293 records' routing texts and made lookup('ai') return 3 wrappers at confidence 1.0, held back only by ambiguous_tie. That is a demonstrated over-trigger, which is the only ground on which design-freeze 1.1 permits dropping a short token; os/ot/s3 occur in 0/293 routing texts and are merely useless, so they stay. The count itself is a floor, not the whole contract: exact membership is enforced by skills/scripts/verify-routing-signals.py.

noise.description: Per-source boilerplate that must not be routable. A pattern is admissible only if it matches at least 80% of the records of at least one source (design-freeze 1.3); the verifier recomputes that fraction against the real registry and fails closed below the floor. Applied to the record's routing text with re.sub(..., flags=re.IGNORECASE), never to the hint.

pattern.description: ECMAScript-style regular expression. Compilability is checked by the verifier.

scope.description: any = name + description + keywords, which is the engine's reference text; description = the description and keyword fields only.

note.description: Human reason, and the measured per-source fraction that admits the pattern.

signals.description: Curated per-record routing rules. A signal fires iff at least one must pattern matches the lower-cased hint and no exclude pattern matches. id is a registry record id and must be unique across the array; the verifier fails closed on a duplicate.

id.description: skills/community/registry.json skills[].id. Existence is checked by the verifier.

must.description: 1..16 ECMAScript-style patterns; at least one must match for the signal to fire.

exclude.description: 0..16 ECMAScript-style patterns; any match suppresses the signal. Optional, defaults to [].

evidence.description: Machine-checkable evidence string, verified under design-freeze 1.2 according to evidence_kind.

evidence_kind.description: record = evidence.casefold() must be a substring of legacy_original_name + legacy_description + source_path. raw = evidence.casefold() must be a substring of a text file inside the record's own directory. Comparison is case-insensitive on both sides; a term that is only present as a different capitalisation is formatting, not evidence.

note.description: Human reason a reader can check, not a restatement of must and not a copy of evidence.
